Comforting one-pot meal.

Ingredients:
Soaking
BASMATI RICE | बासमती चावल 1 CUP
MOONG DAL | मूंग दाल ½ CUP
WATER | पानी AS REQUIRED
Tempering & final cooking
GHEE | घी 1 TBSP
CUMIN SEEDS | जीरा ½ TSP
BAY LEAF | तेज पत्ता 2 NOS.
ONION | प्याज़ 1 LARGE (CHOPPED)
TOMATO | टमाटर 1 MEDIUM (CHOPPED)
TURMERIC POWDER | हल्दी पाउडर ½ TSP
KASHMIRI RED CHILLI POWDER | कश्मीरी लाल मिर्च पाउडर ½ TSP
FRENCH BEANS | फ्रेंच बीन्स 10-12 NOS.
WATER | पानी 4 CUPS
SALT | नमक TO TASTE

Method:
Wash and soak rice and dal together for 20 minutes.
Heat ghee in a pressure cooker, add cumin seeds and bay leaf and let them splutter.
Add onion and saute until translucent. Add tomato, turmeric powder and kashmiri red chilli powder and cook for 2 minutes.
Add french beans, the soaked rice and dal, water and salt & pressure cook for 2 whistles on medium flame.
Do not open the lid immediately.
Serve hot with curd.
